text:
jenna-partners: Quick sync 3 for the upcoming private-offer wave, can we lock graduated pricing thresholds that trigger safeguards (auto-topup, soft-cap alerts) so customers don't get surprise bills?
omar-sales: +1. Prefer thresholds tied to committed monthly USD and tokens rather than flat SKUs. avoids appliance edge cases. :thumbsup:

ria-gtm: We'll need two announcement FAQs: marketplace listing copy and direct private-offer doc. Include clear behavior when thresholds are crossed (7-day grace, invoice hold, auto-topup opt-in).

lucas-legal: Need standard opt-in language for auto-topup and dispute windows. Draft: 7-day grace; customer may dispute overage within 30 days for credit consideration. Will circulate.

sam-platform: Ops side 3 we can emit billing webhooks at milestones (80% / 100% / 120%) and log payloads. Also can support programmatic pause of burst for Private deployments if partner requests it in the offer metadata.

jenna-partners: Also want a minimum price anchor per hardware SKU class to avoid partner-listed prices that break renewal economics.
omar-sales: Suggest renewal discount ladder: Y1 20% off commit, Y2 15%, Y3 10% 3 preserves headline discount while protecting long-term price integrity.

ria-gtm: That ladder works. I'll draft co-announcement copy: "introductory commit discount scales down on renewal" and provide a migration path to reserved capacity.

lucas-legal: Add a "migration credit" clause if Redwood changes model variants that materially change unit economics (e.g., quantization/architecture swap). Predefine triggers and remedies.

sam-platform: Recommend two safeguards in offer schema: 1) Billing webhook + rate-limited auto-topup toggle. 2) Model-variant fallback (cheaper quantized model) when cost per-token spikes. Partner must opt-in.

jenna-partners: Action items: Omar to own pricing schedule draft, Ria to own announcement FAQs, Lucas to draft opt-in verbiage, Sam to spec webhooks and fallback behavior. I'll coordinate with SI leads for enablement playbook.
omar-sales: I'll share a pricing spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow with sample metered->commit ramps, overage calc, and renewal ladder scenarios.

ria-gtm: I'll prepare two FAQ variants and a short partner-facing blurb for listing copy.
lucas-legal: Quick Q 3 should auto-topup default on or off for private marketplace listings?

jenna-partners: Default OFF for private marketplace listings; partner must opt-in to enable. Make it customer-visible.

marketplace-bot: Note: marketplace listing validator passed for draft. Reminder: include `commit_terms` and `auto_topup` fields in offer metadata.

sam-platform: I'll add webhook spec and fallback config to the offer schema PR and gate the feature for Private deployments.

jenna-partners: Good sync. We'll reconvene after Omar's spreadsheet. Thanks everyone. :pray:
